Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

police — the people who keep order and catch criminals. Example: Please call the police.
wanted — searched for by the police. Example: It is a wanted poster.
suspect — a person the police think did a crime. Example: The suspect is about thirty.
height — how tall someone is. Example: He is of medium height.
hair — the threads on your head. Example: She has got long dark hair.
eyes — the parts of the face you see with. Example: She has got green eyes.
description — words that say what someone is like. Example: Write a description of the suspect.
crime — something illegal. Example: Stealing is a crime.
poster — a large printed notice. Example: There is a wanted poster.
catch — to take hold of someone. Example: The police will catch him.
